title: PS5 RPG Lords of the Fallen 2 Locks on to April 2027 Release Date Following Lengthy Delay
summary: The Game Awards teased? Lords of the Fallen 2 is officially targeting an April 2027 release date, having been hit with a lengthy delay back in the summer. The anticipated action RPG was previously eyeing an autumn / fall 2026 launch, which would have only added to an insane PS5 schedule. Shifting to a vague 'Q1 2027' window seemed a wise move at the time. Read the full article on pushsquare.com

title: Call Of Duty’s 19-Year Sales Streak Continues
summary: Circana has released its latest monthly sales report for the US video game industry, and in terms of game sales, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 led the way. It was the No. 1 best-selling game of October 2026, and that's notable because it marked the 19th consecutive year that a new Call of Duty game has been the top-selling title for its launch month.
